dispositions.topic_text: Meaning and exact value of BACKUP_KEY_BYTES
dispositions.reason: State 3 only names BACKUP_KEY_BYTES among data_provider's constants; its meaning is decided where it is read: the _encrypt_backup SECURITY_BOUNDARY note seals under an AES-GCM key of BACKUP_KEY_BYTES derived by HKDF from the configured backup key, so it sizes the derived key, while A17's SECRET_MIN_BYTES bounds the configured secret; the two never constrain the same value (70_data_provider_closure.json rationale, 2026-11-27).
